description:
Seong-Min, who works at Regis, feels eyes watching him in an alleyway one day. However, he is unable to confirm the identity, and the next day he goes to serve at a private room. There, Seong-Min feels similar eyes watching him in the alleyway. That night, while on his way home from work, Seong-Min is being chased by a stalker and meets Yu-Won again. Yu-wWon pretends to recognize Seong-Min and is happy to see him. Seong-Min is flustered by this sudden reunion with Yu-Won, but he also sleeps at his house to avoid the stalker. However, his behavior is somehow strange.

*“… Wait, did I ever tell you my home address?”*

Yu-Won carries out one scheme after another to tie up Seong-Min’s body and mind.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)
